verdict.rationale: Extend's pricing page lists handwriting detection and Agentic OCR among its parse capabilities. Its extraction docs describe per-field confidence scores with citations back to the page, meant for routing low-confidence values to human review, which covers the story's flag-when-uncertain need. However, handwriting support appears only as a one-line feature claim, and nothing ties confidence scoring to handwritten content specifically. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on handwritten field and annotation extraction, explicit evidence that confidence reflects handwriting uncertainty, coverage of annotations (margin notes, markups), independent or hands-on corroboration of handwriting accuracy.
